description:
### Bou 1.4.10

* Dhaka speech: hoyese, dekhesi, likhesi now come out as হয়েছে, দেখেছি, লিখেছি
* Hyphen suffixes: sat-ta, ek-oi, click-i become সাতটা, একই, click-ই
* github, vercel, app, logo and other tech names stay English
* kate becomes কাটে, bakkyo becomes বাক্য

Supports Gboard 18.6.3.100 (arm64).
